items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Downplays knee injury
items.description:
Chase downplayed his knee injury Tuesday, saying it was a "little hyperextension," and he could've kept practicing, Kelsey Conway of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

items.description:

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Limps off field at Tuesday's practice
items.description:
Chase (knee) limped off the field at Tuesday's practice after landing awkwardly while attempting to reel in a deep ball, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
